skeleton: high-contrast Chinese Song/Ming display with clear standard glyph structure
strokeContrast: strong verticals and thin but thumbnail-safe horizontals
terminals: sharp triangular wedges and a few long directional finishes, one dominant accent per glyph
posture: four independent glyphs with distinct slight lean and optical center; not a common baseline
fill: solid opaque high-value neutral; cover decides exact hue
edge: clean cut, no brush grain or glow
spacing: not set by font; each glyph is a separate cover layer

effect.shadow: separate hard-edged neutral gray offset behind each glyph, down-right about 4%–7% of glyph height
